item.title: Ohio State Lands Four-Star Linebacker Quinton Cypher for Class of 2027
item.description: James Laurinaitis is on the board in the class of 2027. Four-star linebacker Quinton Cypher, the No. 192 overall prospect and No. 11 linebacker in the current junior class, committed to Ohio State over fellow finalists Alabama, Miami and Georgia on Friday. Cypher hails from Raleigh, North Carolina, where he's a tackle machine for Millbrook High School. item.title: Michigan Misses on Two Top Head Coach Targets As Kalen DeBoer Leads Alabama to First-Round CFP Win, Kenny Dillingham Signs Contract Extension at Arizona State
item.description: Michigan’s coaching search took two big hits in less than 10 hours. The Wolverines’ other top target was believed to be Arizona State coach Kenny Dillingham. item.title: Amare Bynum Makes First Career Start For Ohio State Against North Carolina in CBS Sports Classic
item.description: It was a matter of when, not if, Amare Bynum was going to become a starter for Ohio State this season. Eventually, the top-75 prospect in the 2025 class was going to start for the Buckeyes as a freshman. That opportunity happened 11 games into his college career, as Bynum made his first career start for OSU against North Carolina in the CBS Sports Classic in Atlanta on Saturday afternoon.
